As of right now, I still have not had my question answered, nor my financial request resolved. My family and I have been loyal customers of PC Financial for over two decades, through numerous Credit Lines, Credit Cards, Chequing and Savings Accounts.

Put almost 3000 dollars onto our card, (4 months of grocery money), after receiving our student loan. Checked 3 days later, and they had reduced our credit limit by... $3000! We now have no money to eat for the next four months, despite 8 years of perfect payment history. Thanks PC Financial for threatening our families' livelihood.

In July I was accosted in Shoppers Drug Mart by PC rep who took my DL info. 30 days later I received & activated my card with $10000 limit. Requested a balance transfer. Told 3-5 days. A week later, card is BLOCKED. No explanation. Then told they couldn't confirm my identity. Want all kinds of personal id faxed to some number (could be INDIA for all I know). Then told they do not keep records of application or DL info from the PC rep at Shoppers Drug Mart. What kind of company mails out cards with $10000 limits and does a credit check only AFTER the customer tries to make a purchase and BLOCKS the card they just activated with a rep on the phone...exactly! So I cancelled the card. PC Financial is incompetent, a scam or both.

I got my MasterCard recently approved for $8000. I spent 1200 the first day, not thinking anything of it. I figured I spend some of it and then pay it back before month end to build my credit. On the 2nd day my CC was declined. When I called them they told me there is a hold on the credit card and I have to pay $600 right away to get the hold removed. They couldn't even wait until month end for the payment. That didn't make sense. The rep. said they were afraid I will spend everything and not pay back. So I asked, then why didn't they just approve me for $1500 and we wouldn't have this problem. Even when I make a payment, now if I ever use it again, I will be thinking will it go through or not. I never had this problem with any other CC before. Would not recommend it to anybody!!!

I was offered PC MasterCard couple of years ago, was given $10000.00 limit on the card, at some point this years I asked to have convenient cheque to pay for renovation in my house, suddenly PC blocked my account for no reason!!! Then when I called they said we need proof of residence and driver's license. I told you could call me and explain why the block. They said they did call, I asked what number, apparently they were lying they had no number to call. After numerous calls again they stated my card, yesterday again this time reduced my credit limit by 7500 dollars, again no reason, truly garbage credit card and extremely bad customer service.

This company offers you a credit card and then cancels it for no reason. Even when your payments are current and not at limit? Poor customer service when asking for explanations. Feel like it's a money grab for their company. They approve everyone then cancel the cards and ensure you pay the entire balance off before you are allowed to apply again. Pretty good way to increase their company face value. Gets the financial world thinking everyone is moving to PC Financial. They should be worried about their back end and retention from the fall out of cancelled cards. May not catch up to them today...but it will. Watch your PC Products. They won't be on top for long, not after this type of discredit starts surfacing.

Due to unforeseen circumstances such as a car accident and job loss, PC Financial CHOSE to cancel my Mastercard even though I paid the balance owing in full. I have no problem admitting that I was late a few times with payments and went over my credit limit due to the car accident insurance deductible, I feel strongly that I should have been given credit for paying the balance in full of $810.

I have my PC MasterCard since 2017 with no issue then one day in April 2018 I discovered that my credit limit had been decreased from $2000 to $1600. Called the customer service and I was told that I had 3 overlimits for the past 2 months. Why they decreased my limit which I don’t see on my statements. So, in May 2018, I started paying twice a month totaling $550 and June 5 I paid $600 to avoid overlimit as they claim. At the end of the day I let it go and moved on. Then today, June 24, 2018, PC Financial reduced my limit again from $1600 to $1100 even though I had not defaulted on my payment obligations.

I have had months of fraudulent charges on my card. I tried to cancel so the charges would stop. They told me this would do nothing. I opened up a dispute, followed everything they said, and provided proof and they still said I lost the dispute. The customer service is a joke. Every rep didn't seem to know what they are doing. They did barely anything to help. They are one of the worst banks I've ever dealt with. Avoid them at all costs.

This company is a joke. I have always been a good paymaster with all my credit cards but never encounter such BS and hassle for having this credit card. I had gotten a supplemental card for my son for emergency usage. Yes he used it and forgot to tell me about it. This happened in July of 2017 hence since I did not know about it and had not received any statements or calls from PC Financial therefore had no idea I had owed them any money. By the way it was $65.55. Only last month I was using their card for making a purchase and was declined. I could not log in my online account and finally called their customer service. They reassured me no problem, after making payment everything will be taken care of.

Have to say that of all the banks I've ever applied for credit this is easily the worst and most tedious in which to obtain anything. If you've recently moved or less than a year at your current address you can expect these guys to demand all sorts of documentation from utility bills to personal cheques for $1 to CRA income statements and besides the cheque, they insist on 'original' documents as if they were the passport office.

I’ve been a customer for quite some time and have always paid on time. Recently one of my dogs got really sick and had to pay higher bills than normal and got me behind in payments. Called customer services a couple of months ago to let them know and the guy said not to worry when I explained the situation and the reason I was behind. Since then I’ve been getting nonstop calls from them and even though I explain again and again the situation and they agreed to stop the calls I keep getting a call a day.

We are two seniors enjoying a winter in a beautiful Mexican town called Guanajuato. We like to put our groceries on our credit card but imagine our shock when our President's Choice Mastercard was returned to us with a "declined" message. I called the customer service line and was told that our account had been cancelled because they had sent out new cards in November and they had never been activated. But I had called customer service while we were still in Canada and told them that I was not going to activate the cards until we got back in March because I had pending reservations on my current card. She said that was fine.

After being a loyal customer for 2 years they closed my account for no reason and this happened 2 days before the Christmas. I was never late for any payments. They basically tricked me saying send us your Identification and a statement copy then they closed my account. Anyone who has an account with PC Financial, don't trust them as they can let you down when you need them and my advice to you, never send anyone any documents as it's just a trap, just like what happened to me. They closed my account after they got the Documents. I would never deal with them ever again.

I'm having a major issue with PC Financial, and I'm thinking it must be because of their recent change in ownership. I've been a customer of theirs since 2000 and haven't ever had this problem. I expect my mortgage payment to be paid by them every 2 weeks always on Friday night. On Saturday it didn't get paid, so I put a bit more money in my account. On Monday night I put in some more money to pay a credit card bill, and realized I put in too much, so I selected the option on the ATM to withdraw a bit. They claim I have a pending payment yet there's no way to verify it. The website is very confusing to use. And there's no online chat to quickly take care of any issues. The $7.95 "express payment" fee is a scam.

This is my second card with Credit One. I see a lot of people bashing this bank. But they tell you everything upfront...you just have to do your part and read it. Yes there a lot of fees, but they take risks on a lot of people and get shafted by a lot of people. They gave me a card when most wouldn't. I have had ZERO issues with them. I know when I make a payment, it will take a few days to show on my available credit. No problem. These cards were not designed to live off of. If you can be responsible, this is a good card to rebuild your credit. Every time I check my credit file, both Credit One and Capitol One show exceptional payment history. It is allowing me to slowly build back the credit I so foolishly ruined.

Beware!!! I accepted an offer I received in the mail for a pre-approved credit card. Once I received the card, the card limit was lower than the "guaranteed" limit promised. There is an annual fee of $75, which was placed on the card right away. When I made my first payment on the card for the balance in full, the card was immediately suspended for a "suspicious payment." However, they don't call or send a notice of any kind, you just can't use the card. Credit One wants a bank statement AS-IS, with all the transactions and balances, and wanted me to also include my FULL bank account number and routing number.

I was happy to have an AMEX card with this bank at first. I knew of the fees. No problem there. But the other credit cards I own, as long as I pay by the date listed. No problem. This company charged me a late fee for paying on the date the bill was due. I'm on SSDI and get paid every month on the 3rd. The date due was the 4th and was told BY A PERSON, that this wasn't a problem. I paid on the 4th to only find out that I was charged a $29 late fee. I called their phone number the next day. First to rescind the late fee, since this was my 2nd month owning this card and the other was to move the day of payment, just 2 to 4 days, because people on SSI or SSDI, get paid once a month and you pay your bills then. Credit One Bank didn't wish to do either but by escalating the call and waiting the 1.5 to 2 hrs, I got them both changed.

Credit One Bank specializes in credit card banking for customers with less than perfect credit. Their main offering is low line-of-credit cards for customers who want to rebuild their credit. Their business strategy is great for short term (less than one year), but beyond 1 year, doesn't make any sense to use. For example, at the end of 1 calendar year as an account holder, they'll bill you $39 annual fee. If your balance is $0, and you never use the card, you might forget this $39 fee exists, and not pay it. After so many days overdue, they'll add a $20 late fee. And if your bank should be low on funds, a $35 returned item fee. So now we're at $94 in fees, all because one $39 charge didn't go through.

I was devastated because I was a value customer at the time until I learn this I call the next day & explain to customer service that I always pay my credit card on time & early. I was told the reason they close my account because a few payments didn't go through which the bank doesn't take payment until the following day. Which I don't understand that either. & I said because other bills was due at the same time, it was just a error but I still don't see the problem if I'm always making payments early & I'm never late. I don't have this problem with my other credit cards. Credit One sucks, this company wasted my time & money. I wouldn't recommend them to anyone. They close my account for no reason. Credit One don't get no stars for me. Disgusted.

I attempted to use the card online and was declined many times. The purchase amount was less than my available credit. I talked to 2- reps, 1 supervisor, and two managers that all gave me inconsistent info and I still can't use the card. They advised my cash advance balance is $75. I let them know the transaction I am making is not a cash advance. I explained I don't have a PIN to this card and never intend on getting on. I was then told that this card is intelligible for balance transfers. I am not trying to deposit money to another credit card or a bank account. All their reps said nothing is wrong with the card and I should be able to use it. I then called the merchant where the transaction was attempting to be made and they confirmed that using a credit card for transactions on their site are not tied to cash advances or cash deposits.

So first off, I’ve been a customer for a year now and I am transferring this account to USAA. These people charge a BIG annual fee, and a fee to pay the bill over the phone. They call you like every two days within the billing cycle if you are behind. I found this out after my debit account was deactivated by my bank for fraud. It’s a family owned business because I have gotten the same four people so far with lots of background clutter. Very pushy and greedy even after I told him the issue.

I recently signed up for the credit card and now received it in the mail. As I am trying to set it up for use with the app, I keep getting error messages saying “for security reasons… blah, blah, blah. Call this number.” So I call the customer service number they provided and it prompts me through until I put in the last 4 of my social security number. Click. The call ended. So, I called back and got a little bit further that time. It rang for a second, then went silent for nearly a minute, and then hung up. I tried for a third and final time and got the same result as the first time. As stated in the title of the review, not off to a great start, Credit One!

2 stars because they approve you for a $300 credit card even if your credit score is low, but with the highest APR of any bank. I had a score of 540 when I opened an account with them and one time I had a payment returned and within a week my credit balance was $563 meaning I was on -$263. My score took a knock to the lowest of lows. This credit card is a business venture and not a way for you if you struggling to make ends meet! The customer service is run from India I presume so you won’t get any help, if you eventually get someone on the line and you ask them too much they just hang up!

After having a bankruptcy I was happy to get things moving along with a new credit card from Credit One. I tried to maintain perfect credit payments, but my attempts actually cost me in a big way. I wound up trying to pay my card off entirely each month, 2 payments reversed from my bank because it was in the overdraft zone. What happened next was my card was closed, my credit score sank to new lows and my life was thrown back into a place I don't wish anyone. I tried to explain the situation to Credit One, but they were not helpful and they blamed the bank. I paid my bill in full soon after. For 2 years I tried reapplying because this is the next card in the steps to rebuilding credit. I kept getting run around and error codes.

I had made online purchases. The purchase did not happen but was changed they still. Doing an investigation. Honey they close. Lost of money. Would not refer their service to my worst enemies. I have credit cards with Capital One online I love.

Instead of working with me to settle the account, customer service and management would rather send me to collections after the 180 days and I can make payment arrangements with a third party debt collector. No assistance offered to close the account.

I threw away $297 to pay off the balance to buy a phone. I have enough to pay the charge. In 2 days $100 of the payment will be on the account. So $197 is not available to use for SEVEN DAYS. And even if I had $150 the spending limit is TEN PERCENT.

Credit One Bank's phone support staff follow a script very closely. Deviating from it or asking for a manager will result in being put on hold, where each time I waited at least 10 minutes before terminating the call. If you have a problem with Credit One Bank, good luck either resolving it or closing your account.

So I signed up a few months ago and tried to setup monthly payments...NOT! So this month I was a day late after explaining I thought the minimum payment was automatic..NOT! I'm 80 years old and don't need this online crap or using my phone like a kid! So I made a monthly payment and can tell you now I am done with this ridiculous card! Oh and because I called today when I got the notice...$28 fee!! This should not be allowed in the world and I won't be a part of it! Lousy service with no way to set up an auto pay!! Oh yeah, I keeping this card...in the trash!!! BEWARE!!

No autopay. Applied twice for a credit line increase and have been denied but was offered a $1500 new line of credit. It doesn’t make sense. If they can offer me a new line of credit of $1500 then why can’t they increase my current account with them? None of the customer service representatives have an answer for this and I can’t get anywhere with asking for a higher up. My current account has always been on time and my credit score is above the 700s and I still can’t get a credit line increase on my current account. I don’t want a new credit card with a new limit. If they can offer that then they can increase my current. I have had nothing but problems with Credit One in the few years I’ve gone business with them.

This place is a scam. They never sent me a card. They said they sent it but it never showed, but the bill would show up. They took it off and said they would send a replacement card. It never showed but the bill did with the original charges on it. Now it's in collections for 400 and I never received a card.

Credit One charges INTEREST on PAYMENTS!! After making the payment for the annual fee, interest was charged as "Interest charges on purchases." The "purchase" displayed was the PAYMENT for the ANNUAL FEE. This is patently wrong and possibly illegal.

I did not open the card with this company and they still trying to hold responsible for it. They won't take it off my credit. I'll advise nobody to go through this card company because they will mess up your credit and you did not even do it.

This has to be by far the WORST credit card company I've ever experienced. I recently got a new credit card with them, with a small credit line of $300. I have higher credit lines that I have never missed a payment. After 1 month I paid $100. Since I was 10 days late because of an issue with my deposit, I get SIX PHONE CALLS every 15-30 minutes in 2 hours. At first I didn't even know it was them. They did not leave any voicemails until the 6th phone call. I called them back and expressed how disturbing and creepy it was to get called, and they explained to me that they do it (for my sake) so that they don't report me negatively to the credit bureau. Which is understandable, but then she wanted to social security number and personal info.

Let me start by saying I am very thankful to Credit One for giving me the chance with no deposit on my initial card. I have had their card since December of 2019 and love it! I started with a $300 limit and used it wisely paying all fees on time and as of now have about 11 cards as they just approved me for $1500 on another card! I see many people complaining about fees and such, they make this VERY clear when you apply for the card. If you can't afford the fees...don't get the card. There are cards out there with no fees like the Capital One Secured Visa which is what I started on with a $250 deposit over a year ago.

I knew there was an annual fee when I signed up. I planned on just paying for the first year and then cancelling before they charged me an annual fee for the second year. The customer service is terrible. It takes too long to get past the automated system because there is no clear route to ask for a human representative. There is actually no option to choose from if you wanted to cancel your card. I had to choose to make an express payment just to get to someone.

My mistake was getting a credit card from a company that feeds on low income (disabled Vet) people by socking them with fees, penalties, and high interest. Stay away! They'll hurt your credit, Not help.

This co is shady! I lost my card that I pay my Credit One with so as a result that payment didn’t go through. I didn’t know. I found out a few days and paid double payment. They took it and still turned me over to collections! Never had bad credit. I’m 63. They are still taking money and I’m in collections! Looking for legal help.

I don't have anything negative to say about Credit One, I've never had a problem with them, I love my card. Simple application process and my card came in the mail quickly. I've read a few bad reviews therefore I was skeptical but so far I've never had a problem with them.

I am was approved for cc. After more than one year they suspend my account because they want to confirm my id. They approved two cc to me and they block two credit cards. One was $99 annual fee and they charge the annual fee. Later they block my account and refused refund the annual fee. I missed $140 for the two cards. I do not recommended deal with that bank. I never paid late.

Overall the card helps me with my credit but I noticed the 1% cash back rewards are not computed accurately, and that shows bad faith in dealing business with them. I have shop at well known places and the customer rep tells me the merchant might not participate in the cash back rewards which is false and then when I do get cash back, it's not the right amount. Shop at Wal-Mart for $54 and Credit One gave me 25 cents back when it supposed to be 54 cents because that would be the 1% cash back, I hope other customers are not getting schemed from their inadequate cash back rewards.

My experience with this company was never good. I was charged a late fee on my account AFTER I had already made a payment on the card. I called the service department and asked them to close the card. They offered to credit back the fee so I kept the account open. Within two months I called to close the card. Come to found out a month later the card was not showing as closed nor had they reported to the credit agencies.

I have used this credit card company to build credit. What a HUGE mistake! Customer service can be described as trying to deal with a box of rocks! They report to the credit bureaus that your payments are late when in fact they are not! I’m still trying to get my credit back because of the incorrect information they reported; I have never missed a payment nor have I been late even through a year long pandemic! I’m submitting this review for any individual within the sound of my words...DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY. YOU WILL REGRET IT!!!!

It's a scam. Yes, they'll send a card to get you started and they charge $9.72 per month and then another $35 yearly. Not even using the card. Be late one day with your $9.72 and get hit with $35 late fee. Try to get a human on the phone? Impossible. I had to get a lawyer to send a letter to cancel the account. It's a scam.

Interest rate is astronomical and never changes. Payments take over a week to reflect in available credit, unless you make an "express" payment with an additional fee of $10. Annual Fee for a bare minimum card. No features or any sort of perks. Customer service has no sympathy and refuses to ever waive the annual fee as a courtesy, even once. No option for Credit line increases, either automatically or options to apply for CLI. Even then, if there is one offered, there is a FEE to increase the credit line.

I was issued a Credit One card 11/20. I used the card and paid the bill in full month account, was closed by credit grantor and they still have my credit report as me overdrawn and or owing a considerable amount of money. The bill was paid in full over 2 months ago!!! Do not use this bank. It caused my credit score to decrease 32 points and I paid my bill in full early!!!

If you can, go with another company! Payments take forever to post! It is RIDICULOUS to have a payment post anywhere from 5-9 days on your account.  As of today I have a balance showing $148.01, available credit of only $51.00!! Yet my payment has been pending for 6days...6 days! This payment WAS NOT from a checking account, as is the excuse they use, but from the same card I always use. This is the normal from them, an excuse to collect more interest from you. STAY AWAY!!

I have had this card for a year and a half. Never missed a payment and always keep my balance very low. I have also rebuilt my credit from a dismal 525 up to a 660. Today I call to ask for a credit line increase from the miserable $300 that I started with, Only to be denied. This card is worthless to me. If I weren't afraid of what would happen to my credit score, I would cancel it now!

Credit One sucks. Will never recommend anyone get their credit card. I have it and have tried several times to get a new card issued due to being broke and all I get is excuses and the runaround to never get a new card issued or solve any problems.

I made the mistake of making 3 payments to my account in 1 billing cycle. I wanted to keep balance low. I was never informed that I could not make more than 2 payments per cycle. My account was frozen and I could not use it. Very embarrassing when I went to use it and it came up... declined. Do not accept... Wow. I called them and was told I had a suspicious payment and I needed to send a copy of my bank statement to verify the payment was legitimate. I must not have gotten it to them in time because they then closed my account!! I got it reinstated however my credit score went down 11 points.

I called regarding a no delivered card twice. The 2nd time I was told I was lying, about the address because they had a different one on file. I had already received other mail about the account to the address the card was supposed to arrive to with the correct address on the form. The rep again said I was lying and will now be making me wait a whole extra month to get a card.

I just wanted to let you know that I have been a Credit One card holder since 9/2017 and I never agreed to be a part of their "Credit Protection" plan, yet they decided to add me anyway. I am not a statement reader and this is why I didn't notice it, until after almost 3 years of being a card holder. On 2/21/21, I noticed a Credit Protection charge and when I contacted Credit One, they said they could only give me a credit for 3 months, to something I never agreed to in the first place.

This company is a joke. They didn’t properly activate my first card, then sent me a replacement and charged me the annual fee twice. I paid one fee, they dropped the other. Then they blew up my phone saying I didn’t pay the fee and now there is a late fee, DOUBLING the amount due. I have NEVER USED THE CARD but owe the $80! After four phone calls and an hour of my time they finally waived the late fee and credited back the annual fee, but never even acknowledged that they had misapplied the money I already gave them. Now I have to wait another 48 hours for all the refunding the woman did this morning before I can cancel the account. I’ll keep my fingers crossed because it seems their sole purpose is to not let you cancel their card and keep just charging fees. High rate, low limit, huge annual fee, and crappy accounting and customer service practices. Just don’t do it. Get a different card from a better company.

I make payments often, after I use my card so it will stay update. You are only allow 5 express payments and standard payments online in a month time. So I call and spoke with 3 different people and they advise me nothing could be done until Monday. I am out of town stranded because I sent my money to put on my credit card and now I have nowhere to stay. I tried to get western union to cancel the payment and they advise me the credit card company would have to cancel it back. This is so sad that they know the money is there but, since they have no one on the weekends to process the payment, I will need to wait until Monday. So I have to find a way to get back home. This is so crazy. Please be careful about making urgent payments, that you pay extra for.

Never do business with this shady credit company again. Your employees lack empathy, don’t contact any one to say, "Hey by the way I saw that ..." then me as the customers would of explain, "What was going was in the hospital and changed banks and must of forgot to update the information with you." I have two cards from Credit One and they were working out ok. They have ALWAYS been difficult to get help in any situation. This time has been a nightmare. Not late pay more than my minimum so for my card to be on hold I was a little ticked. I called three times before I could get any help. That was when I was told I should only make 1 payment a month. So how do I fix it? I had to send a copy of my bank statement showing each payment in separate emails because I made them on different days, same month just two different days.

I have paid monthly fees for this card for years!! Hundreds of dollars over years. I've kept this card, despite the high monthly fees, for emergencies and to help build my credit. Absolutely NOT WORTH it. Wish I had paid more attention to the reviews and complaints before signing up.

I got my card and was extremely excited. I made my payments on time but noticed my other cards gave me increases. I talked to the bank and time after time was turned down. I will not be a cash cow for anyone!

I’m going to mail their card back them and have them sign for the card back to show them this will reach them within a few days like my 1st payment did in November. They also wanted to see if I would give them access to my other accounts for payments, NOT happening! They received any posted my first payment within 3 business days.

Be careful when signing up. Chances are they will give you a credit card no matter what. You may get a $300 credit line. The interest is insane and you will be hit with it no matter what. DON'T sign up for a card. You are better off without it.

My initial payment was $30 on an $81 balance. The due date was 1/14 and I made the payment on 1/7. I got a notification on 1/12 that my payment was returned without explanation. I checked my account to make sure there were sufficient fees, as I rarely carry a balance under $500 in that checking account. The fees were there, and every other transaction I made that day and since had gone through. What’s more, the money was never charged or returned. So while it may have been an error, if my first payment to a company is the only returned transaction I’ve had in years? I'm not comfortable with their standards. I called customer service and got no clear answer on why the payment was returned. I stated that if pay off the balance and to close my account immediately, as I won't be subjected to a $9 instant payment to avoid late fees when I paid a week in advance and wasn't notified until the last minute.

Signed up for the credit card and in 3 months they cancel my card for late payments. First off their payment methods are stupid. They charge $10 to make a payment right away or you can make a regular payment that takes several days to process. On top of that they will call you 10 times a day, even after I talked to someone they still call. Horrible bank.

I have had a Credit One card since June 2020. Since becoming a customer I have always paid my balance due in full every month, but one. Credit One does whatever they want in that regard. Let's explain.

Well I was with Credit One Bank in the past. They gave me a chance. Then later on the account was closed due to hard times. But this year I applied and got a approval of $400. Then the next month was given a increase of $500  I am so grateful for this card.

I closed my mom's account in Feb 2020. She has not used the card. There are no statements on the account until July 2020 stating a zero balance. I called them today and they said the account was never closed! After talking to 6 representatives I finally got it resolved.

Got approved for a card and 60 days later, I have yet to receive my card. Customer service reps barely speak English and are very rude! I had to cancel the previous two cards due to the fact that they were never delivered. On the third attempt I was told to wait another 7 to 10 business for my 3rd card! Would NOT recommend this bank!

It is important as a consumer to know facts and be able to make informed decisions before starting a relationship with a creditor. I opened a card with credit one bank to build my credit back in January 2018 I have never been late until I lost my job during a pandemic. I was on auto-pay and the withdrawal occurred before I could adjust the autopay. Actually it hit my bank twice, in one week.

I have cancel credit card in September 2019. They reopen my account back up without my permission. I have never used their card. I have told them over the phone to close my account. Credit One Bank are Scammers!

I’d been trying to rebuild my credit like most credit one customers (were not customers to this company, simply dollar signs, the word customer infers we be appreciated in some way and shows a little respect as such) first of all I'll say that I appreciated this company taking a chance on me and my less than perfect credit score when giving me a credit card. I opened my account with Credit One about 6 1/2 years ago to build my credit back up. In that time I never missed a payment. I've been trying to get the card I was approved for in September. It's now December and they still claim they have not received my verification after 5 times mailing (within my same state) my personal verifying documents!!

Please read the fine print because there is a fee for absolutely everything when it comes to this card. Even if you make a payment on the due date there is still a fee if it's not paid by 5pm. This card is definitely not worth keeping. To the trash it goes!!!! MISTAKE.

When they say you are pre-qualified, they really mean they are out to take advantage of anyone willing to apply. Charging $100+ before your your first purchase. Sad. They only list this in 5 page tiny print. Beware.
